correctness.rationale: The source gives the short exact sequence with quotient defect \(\mathfrak K\), identifies the companion and pattern terms after scalar extension, and proves that \(T_1-1\) and \(A_1-1\) both annihilate the defect and are relatively prime. At a height-one prime of the Laurent-polynomial UFD, at least one annihilator is a unit; therefore the localized defect is zero and exact localization gives the claimed direct sum. The statement does not infer an infinite theorem from finite computation.

value.rationale: The claim identifies a structural boundary: the satellite-link gluing defect is invisible at every codimension-one point, so all height-one Alexander-module data split simultaneously even though global extension data can remain in codimension at least two. This is a motivated refinement of the source formula, not a parameter substitution or table recomputation, and it clarifies exactly which classes of Alexander-module invariants can detect the genuinely multivariable defect.
